name: Green Card - Family (I-130 + I-485)
summary: Family-based green card for a relative of a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, filed as a concurrent I-130/I-485 package when the beneficiary is in the U.S. and a visa is available.

forms.title: Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA
forms.note: Required for most family-based adjustment applicants (I-485 instructions, Affidavit of Support).

forms.title: Report of Immigration Medical Examination and Vaccination Record
forms.note: Must be submitted with the I-485 or it may be rejected (I-485 instructions, item 9). Sealed by the civil surgeon; not auto-filled.

filing.where: See 'Where To File' on uscis.gov/i-130 (and uscis.gov/i-485 for concurrent filing).
filing.fee: See Form G-1055 fee schedule at uscis.gov/g-1055. Each form has its own fee.

checklist.label: Petitioner's proof of U.S. citizenship or permanent residence
checklist.help: One of: U.S. birth certificate, naturalization or citizenship certificate, FS-240 Consular Report of Birth Abroad, unexpired U.S. passport, or front and back of the Green Card.
checklist.source: I-130 Instructions 04/01/24, What documents do you need to show that you are a U.S. citizen / lawful permanent resident

checklist.label: Divorce decrees or death certificates ending any prior marriages (both spouses)
checklist.help: Needed if either of you was married before.

checklist.label: 2 passport-style photos of the petitioner (taken within 30 days)
checklist.help: 2x2 inches, color, white background. Bring the printed photos to the office; upload a phone picture so we can check them.

checklist.label: 2 passport-style photos of the beneficiary
checklist.help: 2x2 inches, color, white background, taken recently.

checklist.label: Proof of a real marriage (joint lease or deed, joint bank accounts, joint taxes, children's birth certificates, photos together)
checklist.help: Upload as many as you can. Each file can be one type of proof.

checklist.label: Affidavits from friends or family who know your marriage
checklist.help: Each affidavit needs the writer's full name, address, date and place of birth, and how they know about your marriage.

checklist.label: Beneficiary's birth certificate (must list at least one parent)
Petitioner's birth certificate (to show the parent or sibling relationship)
Legal name change documents (if names differ between documents)
Proof of entry: passport visa page, entry stamp, and Form I-94
Sealed Form I-693 medical exam from a civil surgeon
checklist.help: Do not open the envelope. Bring it to the office.

checklist.label: Sponsor's most recent federal tax return or IRS transcript, W-2s, and recent pay stubs
checklist.source: I-485 Instructions 09/18/26, Affidavit of Support; Form I-864 instructions

checklist.label: Certified police and court records for every arrest or charge

points: The petitioner is a {{petitionerStatus}}, as shown by the enclosed status evidence.

For spouses: the marriage was entered in good faith, as shown by the enclosed joint records.
